title: Integer/pixel size for `gap` parameter in `st.container` and `st.columns`
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

`st.container` and `st.columns` both have a `gap` parameter but it's only possible to specify small/medium/large/None. We should additionally allow setting a pixel value. 

### Why?

I had a few situations where I wanted a tiny gap of only a few pixels. `None` felt to small and `"small"` felt too big. 

### How?

Just accept an integer in addition to the existing values, similar to `width` or `height` parameters we have elsewhere. 

### Additional Context

_No response_

I'd like to work on this — planning to support `int` and CSS string values (e.g., `16`, `"16px"`, `"1rem"`) for the `gap` parameter in both `st.columns` and `st.container`. Will follow up with a PR.

Hi, I've submitted a PR implementing this feature — https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14390.

The implementation adds support for `int` and pixel string values (e.g., `"16px"`) for the `gap` parameter in both `st.columns` and `st.container`. Backward compatibility with `"small"`, `"medium"`, `"large"`, and `None` is fully preserved.

Happy to iterate based on feedback!

Implemented in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14995 — `gap` accepts a positive int (pixels) for `st.container` and `st.columns`, plus proto/frontend wiring. CI will need `make protobuf` for generated artifacts.
